screens.name: Birthday editor — populated

screens.name: Birthday editor — partial and impossible date

screens.name: Birth details — initial time entry

screens.name: Birth details — invalid time

screens.name: Birth details — no results

limitations: Scores are provisional browser assessments based on the supplied screenshots and runtime account; no independent runtime execution was performed.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F, with null dimensions excluded.
The requested A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met for every screen and component; strong recovery coverage does not erase the remaining hierarchy, clarity and large-text spacing weaknesses.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied evidence; viewport-edge crops and scrolled screenshots alone do not prove unreachable content.

Transition frames broadly preserve visual roles, but stills cannot establish perceived motion quality or the absence of distracting shifts; timing and performance conclusions rely on the supplied runtime account.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native Dynamic Type, keyboard, speech, haptics, OS sharing and real payments remain unverified and are not certified by these browser scores.
Circles is assessed only for its demonstrated offline and retry states; authenticated online creation, membership and successful recovery are not established.
Synthetic predictions, repeated text, partial fixture sentences and synthetic sources are layout stress material, not production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
The complete expanded invite/reminder section and dedicated purchase-restoration outcomes are not represented sufficiently for full assessment.
No repeated novice usability study is supplied; none of these scores constitutes exemplary-outcome or full/native 9/10 certification.
topFixes: Tighten nonessential vertical spacing at 200% so choices, correction actions and check-in controls appear sooner without reducing enlarged text.
Make long-input scrolling more apparent and separate custom-answer progress from Back to choices.
Clarify unknown birth time, used omen attempts, age-limit meaning and permission-without-sending directly beside the relevant action.
Use neutral reading-detail terminology instead of All evidence and standardize unexplained confidence labels.
Strengthen normal-size secondary guidance and give failure notices a consistent prominent position.
Complete browser evidence for invite/reminder outcomes and restore states, then perform the separate physical-device and assistive-technology pass.
